cr_collision — DRIVE commonroad op

• Data kinds: table × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.cr_collision(scene, run, *, margin: 'float' = 0.0, lanelets: 'str' = 'all') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import drivecommonroad; drivecommonroad.cr_collision(scene, run, *, margin: 'float' = 0.0, lanelets: 'str' = 'all') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("cr_collision"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

障害物との衝突(矩形同士の SAT、time_step ごと)と道路境界(車両 4 角が lanelet 多角形の和集合に入るか)。

lanelets="all"(既定)は場面の全 lanelet(採点器の boundary_collision と同じ範囲)、"route" は経路の lanelet だけ。margin は障害物の SAT を膨らませる距離(m)。

返り値 {"obstacle_collision", "first_collision": (time_step, obstacle_id) | None, "boundary_violation", "first_outside": time_step | None, "n_collisions", "n_outside"}。

Raises ValueError: scene / run が不正、lanelets が "all"/"route" 以外、margin < 0。
